items.definition: Bir olay veya duruma karşı hissedilen, genellikle davranışı da etkileyen güçlü duygusal tepki.
exampleSentences: Fear is one of the most basic human emotions.
She struggled to hide her emotions during the interview.
The therapist encouraged him to express his emotions more openly.

items.definition: Bir kişinin belirli koşullar altında sergilediği, dışarıdan gözlemlenebilen eylem ve tepkiler bütünü.
exampleSentences: The study examined how stress affects children's behaviour at school.
Her sudden change in behaviour worried her close friends.
Rewarding good behaviour is more effective than punishing bad behaviour.

items.definition: Bir bireyi diğerlerinden ayıran, düşünce, duygu ve davranış biçimlerinin kalıcı bütünü.
exampleSentences: Twin studies have shed light on how much personality is shaped by genetics.
His outgoing personality made him popular among his colleagues.
Psychologists use several models to describe different personality types.

items.definition: Bilginin veya yaşanmış deneyimlerin zihinde depolanması ve daha sonra hatırlanabilmesi süreci.
exampleSentences: Sleep plays a crucial role in consolidating long-term memory.
The accident left a lasting memory that still troubles her.
Researchers tested how anxiety affects short-term memory.

items.definition: Zorlayıcı bir durum karşısında bedenin ve zihnin yaşadığı gerginlik ve baskı hâli.
exampleSentences: Chronic stress can weaken the immune system over time.
She learned several techniques to manage exam stress.
Financial problems were the main source of his stress.

items.definition: Bir kişi, nesne veya duruma karşı benimsenen olumlu ya da olumsuz bakış açısı.
exampleSentences: Her positive attitude helped the whole team stay motivated.
The survey measured attitudes toward mental health treatment.
His attitude toward authority changed noticeably after therapy.

items.definition: Bir kişiyi belirli bir şekilde davranmaya yönelten iç sebep.
exampleSentences: Investigators struggled to identify the suspect's motive.
Psychologists study the motives behind altruistic behaviour.
Her motive for volunteering was simply a desire to help others.

items.definition: Belirsiz bir tehlike karşısında hissedilen yoğun endişe ve huzursuzluk duygusu.
exampleSentences: Social anxiety made it difficult for him to speak in front of others.
Her anxiety levels rose sharply in the days before the exam.
Mild anxiety before a performance is completely normal.

items.definition: Sıkça tekrarlanarak neredeyse otomatik hale gelmiş davranış.
exampleSentences: Breaking an old habit takes far more willpower than forming a new one.
Smoking is a difficult habit for many people to quit.
Keeping a journal became a nightly habit for her.

items.definition: Bir uyarana veya olaya karşı, genellikle hızlı ve kontrolsüz biçimde ortaya çıkan davranış veya duygu.
exampleSentences: His reaction to the news was one of complete shock.
The experiment measured participants' emotional reactions to the images.
Her calm reaction surprised everyone in the room.

items.definition: Öğrenilmeden, doğuştan gelen ve otomatik olarak ortaya çıkan davranış eğilimi.
exampleSentences: Maternal instinct drives many animals to protect their young at any cost.
Her first instinct was to run, but she forced herself to stay calm.
Some fears seem to be instinct rather than learned behaviour.

items.definition: Düşünmeden, ani bir dürtüyle ortaya çıkan hareket etme isteği.
exampleSentences: He bought the car on a sudden impulse he later regretted.
Children often struggle to control their impulses.
Therapy helped her resist the impulse to react angrily.

items.definition: Belirli bir nesne veya durumla orantısız derecede yoğun ve mantıksız korku.
exampleSentences: His phobia of heights kept him from climbing the tower.
Exposure therapy is commonly used to treat specific phobias.
Her phobia developed after a frightening childhood experience.

items.definition: Farkındalık hâlinde olan, çevresindeki uyaranların bilincinde olan.
exampleSentences: She remained fully conscious throughout the entire procedure.
He made a conscious effort to control his temper.
Patients are asked several questions to check whether they are conscious.
items.translationTR: bilinçli, farkında olan (bilinç anlamında; 'vicdan' anlamına gelen conscience ile karıştırılmamalı)

items.definition: Kişide derin ve kalıcı ruhsal etkiler bırakan sarsıcı olay veya bu olayın yol açtığı ruhsal yara.
exampleSentences: The accident left him with lasting psychological trauma.
Therapists help patients process childhood trauma.
War often leaves entire communities dealing with collective trauma.

items.definition: Başka birinin duygularını anlayabilme ve onun bakış açısını hissedebilme becerisi.
exampleSentences: Good therapists show genuine empathy toward their clients.
The training programme aims to build empathy among healthcare staff.
She listened with such empathy that he felt truly understood.
items.translationTR: empati (başkasının duygularını anlama ve paylaşma becerisi)

items.definition: Bilgiyi öğrenme, anlama, akıl yürütme ve sorunları çözme yeteneği.
exampleSentences: Researchers debate how much intelligence is inherited rather than learned.
The test claims to measure several types of intelligence.
Emotional intelligence is now considered as important as academic ability.

items.definition: Bir kişinin doğuştan getirdiği ve duygusal tepkilerinin şiddetini, hızını ve süresini belirleyen kalıcı özellik.
exampleSentences: Even as an infant, she had a remarkably calm temperament.
The two brothers had completely different temperaments.
A child's temperament can influence how caregivers respond to them.

items.definition: Belirli bir süre boyunca devam eden, kişinin genel duygu durumu.
exampleSentences: Lack of sleep can have a noticeable effect on your mood.
She was in a cheerful mood after hearing the good news.
The therapist asked him to keep a daily record of his mood.
items.translationTR: ruh hali (psikolojik anlamda; ortamın 'havası' anlamıyla karıştırılmamalı)

items.definition: Kişilerin duygusal veya psikolojik sorunlarını çözmelerine yardımcı olmak amacıyla verilen profesyonel destek ve rehberlik.
exampleSentences: The university offers free counselling to students under stress.
She sought counselling after struggling with anxiety for months.
Trained counsellors provide confidential counselling to victims of trauma.

items.definition: Bir konuda nesnel değerlendirme yapmayı engelleyen, bilinçli ya da bilinçsiz bir yöne kayma.
exampleSentences: Researchers tried to eliminate bias from the survey questions.
Confirmation bias leads people to favour information that confirms their beliefs.
The judge was accused of bias in his handling of the case.

items.definition: Bir grubun bütün üyelerini, gerçekte çok çeşitli olmalarına rağmen aynı birkaç özellikle tanımlayan basitleştirilmiş düşünce biçimi.
exampleSentences: The film challenges common stereotypes about mental illness.
Children absorb gender stereotypes from a very young age.
Her research examines how stereotypes affect hiring decisions.

items.definition: Bireyin, kendi görüşlerinden bağımsız olarak grup normlarına ve beklentilerine uyum göstermesi.
exampleSentences: Peer pressure often pushes teenagers toward conformity.
The experiment revealed how strongly social conformity shapes judgement.
Some cultures place greater value on conformity than others.

items.definition: Bir otoriteye veya kurala koşulsuz uyma davranışı.
exampleSentences: Milgram's famous experiment examined obedience to authority.
The soldiers were trained to value obedience above independent judgement.
Her research questions why obedience can override personal morality.

items.definition: Başkasına zarar verme niyeti taşıyan düşmanca söz veya davranış.
exampleSentences: The study links frustration to increased levels of aggression.
Verbal aggression can be just as damaging as physical aggression.
Therapists teach children healthier ways to manage aggression.

items.definition: Bir kişinin belirli bir madde, davranış veya kişi olmadan işlevini normal biçimde sürdürmekte güçlük çekmesi.
exampleSentences: Prolonged use of the drug can lead to physical dependence.
The therapy aims to reduce his emotional dependence on approval from others.
Psychological dependence can be just as hard to overcome as physical addiction.

items.definition: Toplumun kabul ettiği norm ve kurallardan belirgin biçimde sapan.
exampleSentences: Sociologists study why certain behaviours are labelled deviant in one culture but not another.
The community treated her unconventional lifestyle as deviant.
Labelling theory examines how society responds to deviant behaviour.

items.definition: Bir dürtü, duygu veya davranışın bilinçli ya da bilinçsiz olarak bastırılması.
exampleSentences: Alcohol tends to lower people's normal inhibitions.
Years of strict upbringing left him with strong social inhibitions.
The therapy focuses on overcoming inhibitions that block emotional expression.
items.translationTR: engelleme, çekingenlik (dürtü ya da davranışın bastırılması)

items.definition: Gözlemlenebilen, açıklanması veya incelenmesi gereken olay ya da durum.
exampleSentences: Groupthink is a well-documented phenomenon in social psychology.
Researchers are still trying to explain this puzzling phenomenon.
The phenomenon occurs across almost every culture studied.

items.definition: Önceden düşünülüp planlanmadan, bir anda ve doğal bir dürtüyle ortaya çıkan.
exampleSentences: Her spontaneous laughter put everyone in the room at ease.
The experiment recorded spontaneous reactions rather than rehearsed answers.
Toddlers often display spontaneous acts of sharing without being asked.

items.definition: Kişinin farkında olmadan zihninde etkili olan, bilinç düzeyinin altındaki süreçlere ait olan.
exampleSentences: Freud believed that many of our decisions are shaped by subconscious desires.
The advertisement was designed to appeal to the subconscious mind.
A subconscious fear of failure kept her from applying for the promotion.

items.definition: Gözlem veya deneylerle sınanmak üzere öne sürülen, henüz kanıtlanmamış açıklama önerisi.
exampleSentences: The researchers designed an experiment to test their hypothesis.
Her initial hypothesis was not supported by the data.
A good hypothesis must be possible to prove false.

items.definition: İki değişken arasında, birinin değişmesiyle diğerinin de belirli bir yönde değiştiği ilişki.
exampleSentences: The study found a strong correlation between sleep quality and mood.
Correlation does not necessarily imply that one factor causes the other.
Researchers examined the correlation between stress and memory performance.

items.definition: Bir organizmanın duyularını harekete geçirip ondan bir tepki alınmasına yol açan dış veya iç etki.
exampleSentences: The dog was trained to salivate at a specific auditory stimulus.
Researchers varied the stimulus to see how quickly participants reacted.
A loud noise can act as a stimulus that triggers a fear response.

items.definition: Bir davranışın tekrarlanma olasılığını artırmak amacıyla ödül veya olumlu sonuçla desteklenmesi.
exampleSentences: Positive reinforcement encouraged the children to complete their homework on time.
The training relies heavily on reinforcement rather than punishment.
Without regular reinforcement, the learned behaviour gradually faded.

items.definition: Bir davranışın, tekrarlanan deneyim veya uyaranlar yoluyla öğrenilmesi süreci.
exampleSentences: Pavlov's experiments on conditioning remain foundational to psychology.
His fear of dogs seems to be the result of early conditioning.
Classical conditioning pairs a neutral stimulus with an automatic response.

items.definition: Enerjisini yalnız kalarak yenileyen, sosyal ortamlardan çok iç dünyasına yönelen kişi.
exampleSentences: As a natural introvert, she preferred quiet evenings to large parties.
Introverts often need time alone to recover after social events.
Being an introvert does not necessarily mean being shy.

items.definition: Enerjisini sosyal ortamlarda ve başkalarıyla etkileşim kurarak yenileyen, dış dünyaya ve insanlara yönelen kişi.
exampleSentences: The confident extrovert quickly made friends at the new office.
Extroverts tend to thrive in jobs that involve constant social interaction.
He described himself as an extrovert who loves meeting new people.

items.definition: Bir davranışı, istenmese bile kontrol edilemeyen bir dürtüyle tekrar tekrar yapma eğiliminde olan.
exampleSentences: Compulsive checking of the locks was one symptom of his condition.
She struggled with compulsive shopping whenever she felt anxious.
Compulsive behaviours often provide temporary relief from anxiety.

items.definition: Bir sorunun veya durumun ani ve derin bir şekilde kavranmasıyla ortaya çıkan anlayış.
exampleSentences: Therapy gave her valuable insight into her own patterns of behaviour.
The study offers new insight into how memory declines with age.
A sudden insight helped him solve the puzzle he had struggled with for hours.

items.definition: Bir kişi veya durum karşısında hem olumlu hem olumsuz duyguları aynı anda hissedip hangisine göre hareket edeceğine karar verilemeyen.
exampleSentences: She felt ambivalent about accepting the promotion.
His ambivalent feelings toward his father shaped much of his adult life.
Many participants reported ambivalent attitudes toward the new policy.

items.definition: Rahatsız edici bir duygu veya anıyı bilinçdışına iterek bastırmak.
exampleSentences: She had repressed the memory of the accident for years.
Repressing painful emotions can eventually lead to greater distress.
He learned to repress his anger rather than express it openly.

items.definition: Bir duygu, düşünce veya tepkiyi bilinçli olarak kontrol altına alıp dışa vurmamak.
exampleSentences: He struggled to suppress a yawn during the long lecture.
She suppressed her frustration and calmly explained the situation again.
Constantly suppressing emotions can take a toll on mental health.

items.definition: Zor veya stresli bir durumun olumsuz etkilerini azaltacak şekilde davranışlarını ve duygularını yönetebilmek.
exampleSentences: She found it difficult to cope with the sudden loss of her job.
Regular exercise helps many people cope with everyday stress.
He developed healthier ways of coping with anxiety over time.

items.definition: Sevilen birinin kaybı veya büyük bir yıkım sonrasında yaşanan derin üzüntü.
exampleSentences: The support group helps people work through their grief together.
Grief affects everyone differently, and there is no fixed timeline for it.
She was overwhelmed by grief after her grandmother's death.

items.definition: Zihni sürekli meşgul eden, kontrol edilmesi zor, tekrarlayan düşünce veya ilgi.
exampleSentences: His obsession with the project left him little time for anything else.
The disorder is characterised by obsessions that trigger repeated compulsions.
Her obsession with cleanliness gradually began to affect daily life.

items.definition: Gerçekle bağdaşmadığı hâlde kişinin kesin doğru olduğuna inandığı yanlış düşünce.
exampleSentences: He suffered from the delusion that he was being watched at all times.
The patient's delusions made it difficult for doctors to gain her trust.
Grandiose delusions are a common symptom of the disorder.
items.translationTR: sanrı, hezeyan (gerçek dışı olduğu hâlde kesin doğru sanılan inanç)

items.definition: Yeterli kanıt olmaksızın başkalarının kendisine zarar vermeyi veya kötülük yapmayı planladığına dair aşırı ve mantıksız kuşku.
exampleSentences: Sleep deprivation can sometimes trigger mild paranoia.
His growing paranoia made him suspicious of even his closest friends.
The drug's side effects included anxiety and occasional paranoia.

items.definition: Başkasının acı çektiğini fark edip bu acıyı hafifletmek için harekete geçme isteği uyandıran duygu.
exampleSentences: The nurse treated every patient with remarkable compassion.
Her compassion for the homeless led her to volunteer every weekend.
The programme teaches children to act with compassion toward others.
items.translationTR: şefkat, merhamet (başkasının acısına duyarlılık gösterip yardım etme isteği)

items.definition: Haksızlığa uğradığı düşüncesiyle bir kişiye veya duruma karşı zamanla biriken ve içten içe süren olumsuz bir duygu yükü.
exampleSentences: Years of feeling overlooked at work slowly turned into resentment.
She harboured deep resentment toward her sister for years.
Unspoken resentment can quietly damage even the strongest relationships.

items.definition: Bir kişinin, genetik veya çevresel etkiler nedeniyle belirli bir davranışı, hastalığı veya tepkiyi diğerlerine göre daha kolay geliştirebilecek bir zemine sahip olması.
exampleSentences: Genetics can create a predisposition toward certain mental health conditions.
Researchers found a predisposition to anxiety running in some families.
Early trauma can increase a person's predisposition to depression later in life.

items.definition: Bir kişinin, tek seferlik bir tercihten farklı olarak, karşılaştığı farklı durumlarda tekrar tekrar aynı yönde davranmasına yol açan kalıcı bir özellik.
exampleSentences: He has a propensity for taking unnecessary risks.
Her propensity to worry made even small problems feel overwhelming.
The study explores why some people show a greater propensity for aggression.

items.definition: Bir kişinin, dışarıdan hiçbir zorlama olmaksızın bir eylemi kendi bilinçli tercihiyle gerçekleştirme kapasitesi.
exampleSentences: She left the job entirely of her own volition.
The therapy aims to strengthen the patient's sense of volition.
Choices made under volition feel very different from those made under pressure.

items.definition: Mevcut durumdan aşırı memnun olma nedeniyle daha fazla çaba göstermeye gerek duymama hâli.
exampleSentences: Early success led to a dangerous complacency within the team.
Complacency can prevent people from noticing warning signs of burnout.
The coach warned players against complacency after their winning streak.
items.translationTR: kendini beğenmişlik, aşırı rahatlık/tatmin olma hâli

items.definition: Soyut ilkeler yerine, bir durumda işe yarayacak somut sonuçları temel alarak karar veren.
exampleSentences: Her pragmatic approach to therapy focuses on practical coping strategies.
He took a pragmatic view of the setback and moved on quickly.
The counsellor offered pragmatic advice rather than abstract theory.

items.definition: Bir davranışı veya duyguyu, gerçek nedenini gizleyerek mantıklı gerekçelerle açıklamaya çalışmak.
exampleSentences: He tried to rationalise his outburst by blaming a stressful week.
People often rationalise poor decisions after the fact.
She rationalised her fear of flying as simply being cautious.
items.translationTR: akla uydurmak, mantığa büründürmek (gerçek nedeni gizleyerek gerekçelendirmek)

items.definition: Bastırılmış duyguların dışa vurulmasıyla yaşanan zihinsel rahatlama.
exampleSentences: Writing about the loss gave her a sense of catharsis.
The therapist believes that expressing anger safely can provide catharsis.
For many, crying during the film offered an unexpected catharsis.

items.definition: Kişisel çıkar gözetmeksizin başkalarının iyiliği için gösterilen özverili davranış.
exampleSentences: Evolutionary psychologists debate why altruism exists even toward strangers.
Her decision to donate a kidney to a stranger was a striking act of altruism.
The experiment tested whether altruism increases when people feel observed.

items.definition: Kişinin kendi önemini ve yeteneklerini gerçekte olduğundan çok daha büyük görüp başkalarının ihtiyaç ve duygularını önemsememesiyle belirginleşen kişilik özelliği.
exampleSentences: Mild narcissism is common, but extreme cases can damage relationships.
The study links narcissism to a constant need for admiration.
His narcissism made it almost impossible for him to accept criticism.

items.definition: Bir grubun veya toplumun paylaştığı temel değerler, inançlar ve karakteristik ruhu.
exampleSentences: The clinic's ethos places the patient's wellbeing above all else.
A strong team ethos helped the group work through the crisis together.
The programme was built around an ethos of compassion and respect.
items.translationTR: ethos, bir topluluğun temel değer ve ruhu
